# The Neural Computation and Comparison of Value in Simple Choice

## Overview
This dataset contains fMRI and behavioral data from a study examining how visual attention
modulates decision-related signals in the brain during value-based choices.

## Experimental Design
Participants chose between pairs of food lotteries while undergoing fMRI scanning with
simultaneous eye-tracking. Participants sampled random draws from both lotteries every
4-8 seconds until they were ready to make a choice.

## Data Acquisition
- Scanner: Siemens Magnetom Prisma 3T
- Head coil: 32-channel
- Functional: T2*-weighted gradient-echo, 48 slices, 3mm isotropic, TR=2.6s, TE=28ms
- Anatomical: MPRAGE T1-weighted
- Eye-tracking: EyeLink 1000 Plus at 500 Hz
- 3 functional runs per subject (~15 minutes each)

## Preprocessing Note
The functional and anatomical images in this dataset have undergone minimal preprocessing:
- Slice timing correction (reference: bottom slice)
- Motion correction (realignment to mean EPI)
- B0 unwarping (susceptibility distortion correction)
- Spatial normalization to MNI152 space (SPM12)
- Smoothing with 8mm FWHM Gaussian kernel

Raw unprocessed data were not available at the time of BIDS conversion.

## Participants
- N = 23 right-handed participants
- Age range: Adults
- All had normal or corrected-to-normal vision
- No history of neurological disorders

## Ethics
This study was approved by The Ohio State University Biomedical Sciences IRB.

## Contact
Dr. Ian Krajbich
University of California Los Angeles
krajbich@ucla.edu

## References
Shevlin, B., Gwinn, R., Makwana, A., & Krajbich, I. (2026). Overt visual attention
modulates decision-related signals in ventral and dorsal medial prefrontal cortex.

Data and code: https://osf.io/eyxvb/

## Notes
- Timing Parameters for Preprocessed Data: This dataset uses VolumeTiming instead of RepetitionTime in the functional JSON files. This is because the preprocessed NIfTI files have TR=0 in their headers due to:
- Slice timing correction
- Motion correction
- B0 unwarping
- Spatial normalization to MNI152
- Smoothing (8mm FWHM)
- The actual acquisition used TR = 2.6 seconds. VolumeTiming specifies the acquisition\ntime of each volume (0, 2.6, 5.2, 7.8, ... seconds). This approach complies with BIDS specification for cases where RepetitionTime is unavailable or unreliable due to preprocessing
